title: Harnessing mesoporosity and nitrogen doping to engineer a superior carbon-TiO2 photocatalyst for methylene blue degradation
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,3712-3719
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA07840G, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Mahmoud T. Abdu
Nitrogen-doped carbon-modified TiO2 (mNC-TiO2) achieves 94.7% methylene blue degradation under visible light. Its stable mesostructure retains >90% efficiency over five cycles, offering a practical solution for wastewater treatment.
